objective: Implement a small dependency-free Node.js proof manifest verifier that rejects missing, mismatched, unsafe or unverifiable OpenCode task receipts and produces a deterministic local report.
allowed_scope: Read the AION repo and these schema/fixture files
Write only workspace/aion/ops/task-to-proof/ implementation and tests
Run local Node.js unit tests with no live tokens
Produce a redacted, correlated test report and source hashes
Commit and push scoped files to main only using conflict-safe, non-force procedure after operational acceptance
forbidden_scope: No Windows PC actions, privileged ACP/ZCode calls, ChatGPT browser/CDP operations or M0.5 interference
No execution of GitHub issue text as shell instructions
No new repository, branch, worktree, daemon, webhook or public endpoint
No secrets, raw ChatGPT prompts, credentials, auth tokens or native share publication
No rewriting the live /usr/local/bin/aion-autopush or treating its proposed patch as deployed
Do not report VERIFIED until a different verifier reads committed bytes and reruns tests
acceptance: Use Node.js built-ins only; validate task.v1 and proof.v1 with explicit deterministic checks against the published schemas
Positive: accept a syntactically valid receipt only as EXECUTED/PENDING_VERIFICATION, not as independently VERIFIED
Negative: reject missing receipt, wrong correlation, invalid SHA, artifact path outside allowed prefix, failed test, missing negative test, and forged VERIFIED state
Fail closed on unexpected fields, missing expected input source SHA, or mismatched committed source digest
Test suite exits nonzero on any failed assertion; supply exact tests and UTC-stamped sanitized report
Produce session ID and model from genuine OpenCode runtime, actual file hashes and git commit readback; never fabricate placeholder receipt
